info.title: MiniBox API
info.description: Generated from the operation registry: boxes, volumes, storage pools, snapshots, checkpoints and their schedules, templates, tasks and the event log. Sign-in, host and activity routes, the package upload and download (POST /api/packages and GET /api/packages/{id}/download, raw application/octet-stream), and the streams (GET /api/events/stream, GET /api/tasks/{id}/events and GET /api/boxes/{id}/logs/stream, text/event-stream), are not listed yet.

parameters.name: X-Minibox-Run
parameters.description: Groups the audit events of one client session. 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, colons, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: Box name: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. Surrounding spaces are trimmed.

template.description: Template image: repository[:tag] or a sha256 digest. Omitted, the bundled base template is used.

cpus.description: CPU cores, between 0.1 and 64, rounded to two decimals. Defaults to 2.

memoryMb.description: Memory in MB, an integer between 128 and 262144. Defaults to 4096.

profile.description: Security profile: standard, strict or relaxed. Omitted, the host's default profile is used.

egress.description: Network egress for the box. open, the default, reaches the internet like any container. none gives the box a private network with no route out: exec, SSH and preview still reach it. proxy-only gives it a private network whose only way out is a MiniBox proxy, which forwards to the hosts named by presets and domains and refuses the rest. presets (agent-default, package-registries) and domains (a host, or *. and a suffix for its subdomains) apply to proxy-only only. The proxy logs each host it allows or refuses, never paths or bodies. Changing egress rebuilds the box, so an update or rebuild without confirm true returns the preview.

anyOf.description: Have MiniBox create this role's volume for the box.

role.description: Role volume to create: workspace at /workspace read-write, home at /home/dev read-write, tools at /opt/minibox/tools read-only, cache at /home/dev/.cache read-write. The tools role mounts the host's shared tools volume, creating it when the host has none.

path.description: Optional, and only the role's own path.

mode.description: Optional, and only the role's own mode.

pool.description: Optional storage pool the role's new volume goes to, such as local or an NFS pool name. Omitted, the role's rule picks the pool: cache on the local pool, the other roles on the default pool. A pool this host does not have is refused with pool_not_found. The tools role's shared volume is one per pool, so a picked pool mounts or creates the shared tools volume of that pool.

mounts.description: Mounts this box gets. An entry is { volume, path, mode } to mount a volume that exists, or { role } to have MiniBox create that role's volume for this box: workspace at /workspace read-write, home at /home/dev read-write, tools at /opt/minibox/tools read-only, cache at /home/dev/.cache read-write. A role the list omits is not created. The tools role mounts the host's shared tools volume, and creates it when the host has none. Omitted, MiniBox creates workspace, home, tools and cache. An empty list creates a box with no mounts. Mounting an existing volume needs volume:attach, and a read-write one also needs volume:write. A role volume is new, so every role mount needs volume:write, and the tools role also needs volume:attach when the shared volume already exists. Only the owner or an unmodified admin token may select a pool. A role mount may also name pool, the storage pool its new volume goes to instead of the one the role's rule picks; a pool this host does not have is refused with pool_not_found, and the tools role's shared volume is one per pool.

env.description: Environment variables of the new box. Each entry is { name, value } for a plain value or { name, secretRef } for a secret set with secret.set. Give one or the other. A secret's value goes into the container when it is created and is never returned. A secret that is not set is refused with 400.

idleTimeoutSec.description: Idle timeout in seconds. 0 disables idle sleep for this box; null inherits the global default (BOX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SEC). A positive number of seconds, at most 365 days, or null to clear. Omitted, the current value stays.

ttlSec.description: Time to live in seconds. A positive integer, at most 365 days, or null for none. Omitted or null stores no TTL, except for an agent token with a max TTL, which stores that cap. A value above the cap is refused. When the time elapses the box stops, and its container is kept.

host.description: Host to create the box on: a host id, or auto to pick the online host with the most room that holds the template. When no holder has room for an owner's official template, auto picks the roomiest other host, which builds it. Omitted, the box goes on the local host.

anyOf.description: Host id: local, or the id of a host added under Settings.

hostLabels.description: Labels every candidate host must carry, as an object of key and value pairs, such as { "gpu": "true", "arch": "amd64" }. Only with host: auto, which then considers only the online hosts that carry all of them. A key is lowercase, optionally namespaced with one slash, and a value is a single line of at most 256 characters. Omitted, auto picks among every online host as it always has.

tools.description: Catalog tool ids to record on the box spec (version latest). After create, call reconcile_tools (or install_tool) to install them onto the shared tools volume.

startupCommand.description: A shell command the box runs at every start, once its container has started: as its user, with bash -lc in /workspace and the box's env, in the minibox-init tmux session. It is stored as typed, up to 4096 bytes. It may hold secrets, so only a credential with the secret:use scope reads it back.

selfToken.description: Give the box's agent a self token, written to /run/minibox/self-token, for the self operations. Omitted or false gives none.

repo.description: A Git repository to clone into /workspace. url is https:// or ssh:// or user@host:path, with no password in it. branch is a branch or tag, and omitted means the default branch. secretRef names a secret: a token for https (sent as the password), or a base64-encoded deploy key for ssh. The clone runs only on the first create of a box, and needs an empty writable /workspace.
